profile.headline: humanstartup.ca
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Hi, I'm Toby, a human startup – forever learning and growing, meanwhile trying to have a positive impact.

I studied Software Engineering at the University of Waterloo, where I spent my time building things.

Human Startup is a mindset that I've adopted over the years while working at numerous startups. The idea is to be a curious learner, constantly improving and driven to innovate. All the while, staying humble and thinking about how I can positively impact people's lives. That's what I really care about. Join me and live life like a startup! 🚀

I invite you to see some of my work and chat about how we can collaborate!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Paddle uses a smart matching algorithm to match existing talent to job openings in your company. That equals big savings & happy employees.

positions.title: Front-End Developer and Graphic Designer
positions.description:
Prospect Madison is a technology company that enables individuals to pursue broad and socially impactful careers with clients including Stanford University, Community Foundations of Canada, and General Electric.

• Established Prospect Madison's online presence by constructing and maintaining its website
• Designed and developed a custom WordPress template, using JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS3
• Collaborated with a team of 5 to create Prospect Madison’s first and ever growing brand book
• Advised the company on UX and UI during the development of its Broad apps
• Designed 36 archetype graphics, which are essential to Prospect Madison’s self-assessment tools

positions.title: Web and Graphic Designer
positions.description:
The Intersector Project is a non-profit organization that seeks to empower practitioners in the business, government and non-profit sectors to collaborate to solve problems that one sector cannot solve alone.

• Maintained and updated the company's website with new content, such as videos, blogs and reports
• Directed two commercial-like videos, with 1000+ views, that syndicated the company's vision
• Interviewed cross-sector leaders in the city, including Stan Litow, President of IBM’s Foundation
• Illustrated a 30-page agenda for the White House Forum on Cross-Sector Leadership

positions.title: Founder and Lead Designer
positions.description: Teehee! Apparel produces feel good clothing to promote self-confidence and integrity. (http://teeheeapparel.com)

positions.title: Marketing Intern
positions.description: I created graphics and videos for the Tri-Sector Forum, and transcribed interviews of tri-sector athletes. In addition, I interviewed active and engaged teenagers in the community to gain a younger perspective on the concept. Through this experience, I developed a greater understanding of cross-sector leadership.

volunteerExperiences.description:
CanLeads seeks to make the Canadian parliament representative of the overall population by identifying and training high-potential under-40 candidates running for federal riding nominations in 2019 and beyond.

• Constructed and maintained CanLeads’ website, using WordPress, establishing its online presence
• Illustrated graphics of charts and models, used on the website to captivate CanLeads’ audience
• Implemented various scripts and functions to the site, making it more responsive and mobile friendly
• Through this experience, I learned the importance of youth engagement in politics

Enactus Waterloo is a student-led, social enterprise dedicated to improving the quality of life and standard of living, by implementing projects that achieve the triple bottom line: people, planet and profit.

Consult and design for Enactus Waterloo's Project Spider, which is a simple content management system (CMS) aimed to assist small businesses in entering the World Wide Web.
